verdict.rationale: Segment ships AI-powered features, such as AI-powered audiences, so it is plausible for it to act as an MCP client. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of connecting external MCP servers or letting Segment invoke their tools. The 'Open in ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor' links are documentation-page sharing buttons, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
